pool.title: Bellows Bench
pool.pitch: The phone becomes the tool — the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page for jewelry workshops: piece tracking minutes after the work happens, auto-makes a 30-second recap the owner will repost.

pool.title: Lintel for maintenance teams
pool.pitch: Work orders without the paperwork: the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page built for maintenance teams, ends in printed QR cards for the wall.

pool.title: Cleat for stall chains
pool.pitch: Trainees breaking real things plagues stall chains. The fix: filmed tasks become step-by-step SOPs with checkpoints, output supply counts, the expert approves and the system does the rest.

pool.title: Produce Quality Inspector
pool.pitch: Automatically grade fruits/vegetables from photos for market standards

ranking.attack: The training angle for stall chains is fresh and addresses a real pain point with SOP automation.
Creative use of manual pages for jewelry workshops with auto-recap is unique but less ambitious.
QR cards for maintenance teams is practical but feels like a slight variation on the theme.
Produce grading is a solved problem with no creative twist on the concept.
Voice-to-text for jewelry workshops is thin but feasible with real business value
Similar to Bellows but less clear value proposition for maintenance teams
Over-scoped: video analysis, supply counts, and approval system too complex for 8 days
Image grading for produce is well-trodden territory with no clear differentiator
Limited validation on real-world implementation beyond basic image recognition
Niche application with limited scalability beyond jewelry workshops
Similar concept to Bellows Bench but with less creative application
Underutilizes Meta models, only basic image segmentation without advanced features
Visual SOP generation from filmed tasks with expert approval creates instant payoff
Jewelry piece tracking with auto-generated recap shows immediate value
QR cards for maintenance manuals provide tangible demo moment
Fruit grading lacks visual excitement and demo potential
Vague SOP creation; no proof of expert approval workflow
'Work orders without paperwork' lacks quantifiable time savings
Manual page tracking unclear; no artifact specified
Common application; no named worker or defensible savings
